name: Do I need a deadbolt on all exterior doors?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a deadbolt on all exterior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is highly recommended to install a deadbolt on all exterior doors, including side and back entrances, not just the front door. Intruders often target less visible entry points. A deadbolt provides an additional layer of security beyond a standard doorknob lock, making forced entry significantly more difficult. Ensuring consistent security across all access points is a key step in protecting your property. Maine Results, Inc. can help you assess all entryways and ensure comprehensive security coverage for your home in Kuna or Meridian.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it's highly recommended to install deadbolts on all exterior doors for consistent security, as intruders may target less visible entry points.
